{{Quote|Cracknels for the ladies.''"<br />"''Awesome.|[[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], when serving [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] some Cracknels|<ref name="Star Wars Detours">''[[Star Wars Detours]]''</ref>}}
The '''Cracknel''' was a popular appetizer. In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt's]] personal [[chef]] [[Porcellus/Legends|Porcellus]] considered serving cracknels to his master.<ref name="Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef">{{StoryCite|story=Taster's Choice: The Tale of Jabba's Chef|book=Tales from Jabba's Palace}}</ref>

{{Food-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The cracknel would have made its first visual appearance in the unreleased and non-canon series ''[[Star Wars Detours]]'', where they were depicted as a kind of blue-colored finger food served at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] sometime before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] had eaten it regularly there since she was a young child. She enjoyed eating it with plenty of [[Pepper/Legends|pepper]].<ref name="YouTube-Star Wars: Detours - Extrait #3">{{YouTube|channel=@holonet|name=Star Wars HoloNet|text=Star Wars: Detours - Extrait #3|video=j5r28SwZk7Y}}</ref>
